book.title: Saveeŋ Tau Ipaghazoŋai Ŋgar Yoŋgaaŋa To Maaron Kamapim Tok Hait—Revelation

content: Tamtamon tiyamaan katin aatyavyav to Maaron
Ra nalooŋ saveeŋ luutu tiina ivot ila rumei loolo ta sambam we, ve ilam pa aŋela liim ve ru tana ighe: “Aatyavyav to Maaron tau igheen ila oon tsiam lolozi na, ala aliŋi izila pa taan.”

Ra aŋela tau imin maata na, igham oon tooni, ve imuuŋ ila iliŋ aatyavyav to Maaron izila pa taan. Tauvene yes tau tigham ilaal to gabua saghati ve tipait gabua tawe anunu na, mbotmboot igham zi. Mbotmboot tawe poia mako. Sasaghati, ve yavyavuuŋa tiina kat.

Mako aŋela ite imin ru, aana igham oon tooni, ve ila iliŋ aatyavyav to Maaron izila pa te, le te itoora imin siŋ to yes mateegha. Tauvene gabua naol isov tau tileep ila te loolo na, timatmaat le tisov. Eta ileep muul mako.
Mako aŋela ite imin tol, aana igham oon tooni, ve ila iliŋ aatyavyav to Maaron izila pa yaa, le yaa tisov timin siŋ paam. Yaa tau tirereer, ve yaa tau tivotvot ila taan puura na paam.
Ve nalooŋ aŋela tau iŋgin yaa na, isaav pa Maaron ighe:

content.text: “Yo uleep muuŋ geeg, ve aazne paam. Ve yo patabuyaaŋ kat.
Ŋgar tau yo ughamu to uyat ŋgar sasaghati to tamtamon, ene iduduuŋ mon.
Pasaa, yes tiliŋ siŋ pa tamtamon tsio patabuyaaŋa, ve yes propet. Tauta anam ugham zi tighun siŋ. Atuya toozi tawe, ene iduduuŋ kat pa ŋgar tau yes tighamu na.”

content: Ve nalooŋ saveeŋ ivot pa artaal ve ilam ighe: “Onoon kat. Maaron, Tiina tsiei, yo saksakim ve uŋgin gabua naol isov. Gabizooŋ tsio ve atuya tau ughuru pa tamtamon, ene iduduuŋ ve onoon mon.”
Mako aŋela ite imin paaŋ, aana igham oon tooni, ve ila iliŋ aatyavyav to Maaron iŋarui aaz. Tauvene aaz ighaaz kat, ve isalaam tamtamon imin yav.
Aaz ighaaz katin zi le tinizi ipopop. Eemon lolozi pa toraaŋ ŋgar toozi mako ve tipait Maaron eeza mako. Tiburig ve tisik saveeŋ sasaghati naol pani. Pasaa, yes tiwatagh: I ta iŋgin pataŋani tawe.

Mako aŋela ite imin liim, aana igham oon tooni, ve ila iliŋ aatyavyav to Maaron izila pa gabua saghati niia to ghamuuŋ pooz. Tauvene yes tau tileep ila i saamba na, ndoroom tiina ikau zi. Ve yavyavuuŋ tiina igham tamtamon le livozi kikia.
Tauvene tisik saveeŋ sasaghati naol pa Maaron to sambam. Pasaa, yavyavuuŋ tiina ve mbotmboot sasaghati igham zi. Eemon titoor lolozi ve tipul ŋgar toozi sasaghati mako.
Mako aŋela ite imin liim ve ee, aana igham oon tooni, ve ila iliŋ aatyavyav to Maaron ila pa yaa tiina Euprates, le imaak ve imamaas. Leso igharaat eez pa yes kinik to aaz puughu tilam.
Ve naghita avuvu sasaghati tol. Ghitoŋazi imin gob. Ee ivot ila moot aavo, ite ivot ila gabua saghati aavo, ve ite imin tol pani, ene ivot ila propet karom tau igham gabua saghati naagho na aavo.

Avuvu sasaghati tawe pale tigham gabua ŋgeretazi tintiina ivotvot imin ilaal pa tamtamon. Isaav ighe saawe tiina to Maaron saksaki igabiiz tamtamon ve ighur atuya pazi ilam igharau, ene pale tila tipazaagh yes kinik irau taan isov, leso tiyau zaaba toozi tilam, ve tipaburigin malmal pa Maaron.

[Ve matamim iŋgal Krisi aliiŋa tau isaav ighe:] “Alooŋ. Yau aat nalam napateeŋ gham imin ŋeer to umbuuŋ. Tauvene tamtamon tau ighe igharaat ghi pataghaaŋ, ve imamaat ariaaŋ le nalam, ene aat tintini pa poia to Maaron tau pale izaa tooni. Eemon isaav ighe tamtamon eta igharaat ghi mako, ene pale ivaghamgham, ve maaya imin ŋeer tau kambaŋmbaŋi.”
Tauvene avuvu sasaghati tawe tila tiyau yes kinik tomania zaaba toozi ve tilup zi izi nugh tau tiwaat eeza ila saveeŋ Hibru tighe Armagedon. Leso tigham malmal izi ta sewe.

Mako aŋela ite imin liim ve ru, aana ila iliŋ aatyavyav to Maaron izila pa sambam saamba. Ve saveeŋ ivot toman luutu tiina ila Maaron niia to ghamuuŋ pooz ta Rumei Tiina loolo we. Isaav ighe: “Tauta ene. Isov wa!”

Ra nugh ighani milia, lalaav pelia, ve luutu guruŋguruŋia, ve yogyoog itok. Yogyoog tawe, tiina le tiina kat. Saawe tau Maaron ighur tamtamon tivot izi taan ve ilam, yogyoog tiina eta tauvene itok taan pai eta soone.
Yogyoog tawe igham taan to nugh tiina Babilon ivavaal le imin sirivu tol. Ve nugh tintiina to taan tisov tauvene paam, tisaghat ve timbiriis. Tauvene Maaron loolo iveegh pa nugh tiina Babilon
sosor tooni mako. Maata iŋgalŋgali, tauta ipaghunu pa vaen ariaaŋa kat. Vaen tawe, ene aatyavyav tooni tau tiina le tiina kat.
Saawe tana, sisi tisov tilalez. Ve loloz paam, eta igheen muul mako.

Ve ais paatu paatu titaptap sambam tizizi, ve tiravrav tamtamon. Ais paatu paatu tawe, geegeu mako. Pataŋani to paatu eŋaeŋa, ene irau 50 kilogram ma vene. Tauvene tamtamon tisik saveeŋ sasaghati naol pa Maaron. Pasaa, pataŋani tawe, tiina le tiina kat.

footnotes.text: Babilon, ene izaa to nugh tiina Rom, tomania ŋgar naol to taan tau ighegherev tamtamon gha tighur murizi pa Maaron. Yoan loolo pa watooŋ Rom eeza duduuŋ mako, tauta iwaato ighe Babilon.
